tahiti.head: A real lounger in a small footprint.
tahiti.why: People choose the Tahiti because it fits where bigger tubs don't: a small deck, a townhouse patio, a tucked-away corner of the yard. It still gives you a full lounger to stretch out in, and it plugs into a regular outdoor outlet, so you can be soaking the weekend it arrives.
perfect: It's mostly the two of you, with room for one more
You want to lie back and stretch out, not just sit
Your space is tight, about 7 ft by 5 ft 5 in
You'd rather not hire an electrician to get started
It's your first hot tub and you want to keep it simple
tahiti.seating: Two seats and one lounger, each with its own mix of jets, so every spot feels a little different.
tahiti.honest: On a regular 120V outlet the heater is small, so it warms up slowly after you add cold water. If you'll be in it every night through January, ask me about wiring it for 240V. The same tub goes from a 1 kW to a 4 kW heater.

st-lucia.head: Four upright seats, face to face.
st-lucia.why: The St Lucia is for people who sit up and talk. Four seats and no lounger means nobody is stretched out across the tub and everyone gets a proper seat. It plugs into a regular outlet, it has Wi-Fi so you can check on it from your phone, and it comes ready for a heat pump if you want to add one later.
perfect: You soak to talk, more than to lie back
It's two to four people most nights
You like checking and adjusting things from your phone
You might heat it with a heat pump down the road
You want to plug in and go, with no electrician
st-lucia.seating: Four upright seats, each with its own jet layout, so you can trade spots and get a different massage.
st-lucia.honest: This tub is built for conversation more than deep massage. If a sore back is the real reason you're shopping, the Palma or the Tahiti will do more for you.

reims.head: Six people and a lounger, on a regular outlet.
reims.why: Most people assume a six-person tub with a lounger needs a 240V hookup. The Reims doesn't. It plugs in, it's a 6 ft 7 in square that fits most decks and patios, and it gives a family a lounger plus five seats without a big electrical job before the first soak.
perfect: You're a family of four to six
Someone in the house always claims the lounger
You want to skip the electrician on day one
You're watching the budget and still want room for everyone
You like the clean look of a white shell
reims.seating: Five seats and one lounger, each placed to work on a different set of muscles.
reims.honest: One pump on a regular outlet gives a gentle massage, not a deep one. If you want stronger jets at every seat, the Refresh and the Palma are the same size and run on 240V.

refresh.head: Full-body lounger and real pressure, at a value price.
refresh.why: The Refresh is the same 6 ft 7 in square as the Reims, but it steps up to two pumps and 49 jets. Each seat has its own control, so the person who wants it strong and the person who wants it gentle can both get their way in the same soak.
perfect: Different people in the house like different pressure
You want a full-body lounger
A 240V hookup isn't a problem for you
You want more massage without jumping to a pricier line
You like that the side panels come off easily for service
refresh.seating: One full-body lounger and five sculpted seats, with the pressure adjustable seat by seat.
refresh.honest: If massage is the main reason you're buying, look at the Palma. It's the same footprint with 83 jets.

palma.head: The massage pick of the Deluxe line.
palma.why: 83 jets in a 6 ft 7 in tub is a lot of massage for the space. The big 5 inch jets give broad, deep pressure across your back, and the dozens of small jets work into the tighter spots. People buy the Palma when they want real hydrotherapy at a Deluxe price.
perfect: Your back or shoulders are sore at the end of the day
You want deep massage without paying for a bigger line
You'd like a full lounger plus five seats
Your yard fits a 6 ft 7 in square
You want different seats for different kinds of massage
palma.seating: One full-size lounger and five sculpted seats, with 7 large, 14 medium and 62 small jets spread between them.
palma.honest: If you want even more power and more water around you, the Tokyo and the Maximus in the Premium line go further. For most sore backs, though, the Palma is plenty.

st-tropez.head: Seven seats, and still a plug-in.
st-tropez.why: The St Tropez seats seven and still plugs into a regular outdoor outlet. Every seat is upright, so it's made for a group sitting around and talking. Each seat has its own pressure control.

st-tropez.seating: Seven upright seats in a 6 ft 7 in square, with jets aimed at different muscle groups at each seat.
st-tropez.honest: Seven people in a 6 ft 7 in tub is cozy, and one pump gives a gentle massage. If you host often and want more power and room, look at the Seville or the Colombo.

seville.head: Seven upright seats, built for family nights.
seville.why: The Seville is an all-seater with two pumps and 48 jets. Everyone sits facing each other, the pressure at each seat can go from gentle to strong, and the waterfall and fountain effects add a nice sound in the background.

You'd rather sit up than lie back

You love the sound of running water
seville.seating: Seven upright seats with rotating jets for deeper massage and directional jets for gentler relief.
seville.honest: There's no lounger. If someone in your family wants to stretch out, the Santorini gives you a lounger and five seats.

topaz.head: Made for two people who both like to lie back.
topaz.why: The Topaz is the smallest tub in the Premium line, and it puts two adult loungers side by side. At just over 5 ft wide it fits narrow spaces, and with two pumps and 64 jets it doesn't give up any massage for its size.
perfect: It's the two of you, and you both want the lounger
The kids have grown up and moved out
Your space is long and narrow

Your soak is your quiet time together
topaz.seating: Two adult-sized loungers and one seat, with sculpted headrests and an illuminated waterfall.
topaz.honest: With only one regular seat it isn't a tub for entertaining. If you'll have guests over, the Barcelona keeps the two loungers and adds three seats.

barcelona.head: Two loungers, so nobody fights over the best seat.
barcelona.why: In most tubs there's one lounger and everyone wants it. The Barcelona has two, and three more seats so the loungers still work when the tub is full. Three pumps drive 86 jets, so there's real power behind every spot.

barcelona.seating: Two full loungers and three seats, each set up to work on key muscles and pressure points.
barcelona.honest: Fewer upright seats means it isn't the best pick for six people every week. For bigger groups, the Tokyo or the Oslo will suit you better.

maximus.head: The most massage we carry.
maximus.why: The Maximus is the biggest and deepest tub we sell. Four pumps run 99 jets, and at 39 inches tall with 420 gallons of water there's a lot of warm water around you. People buy it when hydrotherapy is the whole point.

maximus.seating: Five seats and a sculpted lounger, with rotating jets for the back and shoulders and directional jets for arms, legs and feet.
maximus.honest: It's our largest footprint, 8 ft 6 in by 7 ft 3 in, and it's heavy once it's full. It needs a solid, level base, so talk to me before you put it on a deck.

santorini.head: A balanced family tub that fits most yards.
santorini.why: The Santorini is the middle of the road in the best way. It has a lounger for solo time and five seats for family time, with 52 jets spread so every seat gets massage where it's needed. At 6 ft 11 in square it fits more yards than the bigger Premium tubs.

santorini.seating: Five seats and one lounger, with sculpted headrests, drink holders and illuminated waterfalls.
santorini.honest: If massage is the priority for the whole family, the Tokyo gives you 89 jets and three pumps in a tub only a few inches bigger.

tokyo.head: Serious hydrotherapy for the whole family.
tokyo.why: The Tokyo has three pumps and 89 jets with the same seating as the Santorini: a full lounger and five seats. It's for families where everyone wants a real massage, not just the person who grabs the lounger first.

tokyo.seating: Five sculpted seats and one full lounger, mixing rotating jets for deep pressure and directional jets for gentler relief.
tokyo.honest: If you want the most massage possible and have the room, the Maximus goes further. For most families, the Tokyo is the sweet spot.

colombo.head: Seven seats and big jets, built for entertaining.
colombo.why: The Colombo seats seven upright and is loaded with large 5 inch jets, 17 of them, which give broad, deep pressure across your back. Waterline and underwater lighting make it look great at night, so it's a tub people buy for hosting.

colombo.seating: Seven upright seats with 17 large, 9 medium and 22 small jets, plus drink holders and headrests.
colombo.honest: There's no lounger. If someone wants to lie back, look at the Santorini or the Tokyo.

oslo.head: Room for the whole crew, with power to match.
oslo.why: The Oslo is a 7 ft 7 in square with seven upright seats, so there's more room per person than in a smaller seven-seater. Three pumps run 64 jets, so a full tub still gets good pressure.

oslo.seating: Seven ergonomically sculpted seats with headrests, drink holders and illuminated waterfalls.
oslo.honest: It's a big tub. Measure your space and the path to your backyard before you fall for it, and I'll help you check.

capri.head: The cleanest water we sell, in a compact size.
capri.why: The Capri gives you the full Luxury water care, UV, ozone, an ozone mixing chamber and a mineral ionizer, in a tub only 6 ft 7 in by 5 ft 7 in. People choose it when they want the water to mostly look after itself and don't need a big tub.

capri.honest: There's no lounger. If you want to stretch out, the Positano and the Florence have Luxury water care and a lounger.

portofino.head: Room to spread out, with water that looks after itself.
portofino.why: The Portofino is a roomy 7 ft 7 in square with four seats and a lounger, so five people have space. Three pumps drive 66 jets, the Luxury water care keeps things clean with less effort, and you can run it all from the Wi-Fi app.

portofino.honest: If 7 ft 7 in is more tub than your yard has room for, the Positano has the same seating in a 6 ft 11 in square.

positano.head: Luxury water care with a lounger, in a mid-size tub.
positano.why: The Positano has four contoured seats and a full-body lounger in a 6 ft 11 in square. You get the full Luxury water care and phone control, with cup holders built into the rim, in a size that fits most backyards.

florence.head: The most jets in the Luxury line, in a 6 ft 7 in tub.
florence.why: The Florence fits five seats and a full lounger into a 6 ft 7 in square and has 67 jets, the most in the Luxury line. Add the Luxury water care, a lit waterfall and fountain jets, and it's a lot of tub for a modest footprint.

florence.honest: Six adults in a 6 ft 7 in tub is cozy. If you'll often have a full tub, the Palermo or the Portofino give you more room.

palermo.head: Six upright seats for long conversations.
palermo.why: The Palermo is an all-seater in a roomy 7 ft 7 in square. Every seat is sculpted, three pumps power 61 jets, and the Luxury water care keeps things clean when you have people over. It's a tub made for talking.

sicily.why: The Sicily is a six-seat all-seater in a 6 ft 11 in square with the full Luxury water care. You can preheat it from your phone on the way home, stream your music through the speakers, and spend very little time on the water.
